summary: Nez Perce National Forest lookout about 20 miles SSW of Elk City; listed abandoned or gone, with no history or site description in the sources.

facts.status_note: The 2010 Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts say abandoned; the FFLA index says gone; no source describes what remains

evidence.supports: about 20 miles SSW of Elk City
27 miles SSW of Elk City (conflicts with the 2010 list's 20 miles)

listed as abandoned under history (Idaho Fire Lookouts)
lists the site type as unknown

corrections.why: Only the FFLA index marks it gone, with no detail. The 2010 Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts say abandoned, which does not show that nothing stands.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives 27 miles SSW of Elk City; the 2010 Forest Service list gives about 20 miles (T25N, R6E Sect. 26). The story gives the Forest Service figure and reports the other.

sources.title: Nez Perce National Forest Lookouts (compiled April 2010 by Cindy L. Schacher)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: four sources, no construction year, no builder, no description of the site. The record's gone status rests only on the FFLA index, which gives no detail; the 2010 Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts say abandoned (see corrections). The Idaho County A-L page lists the Nez Perce entry at 25N-6E-26 with no history lines, so it adds nothing. Two web searches turned up no further history. No photos. A reviewer should check the status column of the 2010 list and look for local history before publishing.
